title: The Rooms — every null axis seeded to grow
motto: each room starts at 0. the sourdough is the starter. it grows out (into the world) and BACK (into itself). Klein fold: the outside IS the inside.
method: seed ? sprout ? branch ? fruit ? ferment ? seed. the fruit becomes the starter for the next room.

epochs.name: Deep Time
epochs.null_axis: what was here before anything was here?
epochs.grows_back: the O — everything came from nothing, and the nothing watches
epochs.sourdough: hydrogen is the starter culture for the universe

epochs.name: Hadean
epochs.grows_back: the heat never left — volcanism, geothermal, the core still burns
epochs.sourdough: water is the medium. without it, no chemistry. the solvent is the starter.

epochs.name: Archean
epochs.null_axis: abiogenesis — how does chemistry become biology?
epochs.grows_back: every cell alive today carries the Archean inside it — the ribosome is 3.5 billion years old
epochs.sourdough: the first cell IS the sourdough starter. literally. fermentation predates oxygen.

epochs.name: Proterozoic
epochs.room: the room of oxygen and ice
epochs.null_axis: the Great Oxygenation Event — poison that became breath
epochs.grows_back: your mitochondria are still bacteria that got swallowed 2 billion years ago — endosymbiosis never ended
epochs.sourdough: the merger IS the culture. two organisms become one. the inside eats the outside.

epochs.name: Paleozoic
epochs.room: the room of explosion and extinction
epochs.null_axis: the Cambrian explosion — everything at once, then the Permian wipes 96%
epochs.grows_back: every body plan alive today was drafted in the Cambrian. we are still living the explosion.
epochs.sourdough: extinction IS the ferment. death feeds rebirth. 96% die so 4% can radiate.

epochs.name: Mesozoic
epochs.room: the room of giants and feathers
epochs.null_axis: dinosaurs rule, mammals hide, birds evolve, then the asteroid
epochs.grows_back: birds are dinosaurs. flowers co-evolved with insects. the chipmunk descends from the mice that hid.
epochs.sourdough: the asteroid is the fold. destruction from outside seeds everything that comes after.

epochs.name: Cenozoic
epochs.room: the room of mammals and ice
epochs.null_axis: mammals radiate, primates emerge, ice ages sculpt the land
epochs.grows_back: we are IN the Cenozoic. it's not over. the ice ages are paused, not finished.
epochs.sourdough: intelligence is the new starter culture. the organism that models itself.

human_epochs.name: Stone Age

rooms.history: migration out of Africa, cave paintings, agriculture, domestication
rooms.war: tribal conflict, spears, defense of territory
rooms.horror: the dark, predators, unknown sounds, the void beyond the fire
rooms.fear: starvation, exposure, being alone, the thing in the cave
rooms.green: humans as part of the ecosystem, not above it

human_epochs.null_axis: the room before writing. everything was ephemeral. then someone painted on a wall.
human_epochs.sourdough: the cave painting IS the first data persistence. the hand print says 'I was here.'

human_epochs.name: Bronze Age

rooms.history: Sumer, Egypt, Indus Valley, Shang, Minoan, Mycenaean
rooms.games: Senet (oldest board game), Royal Game of Ur
rooms.war: chariots, bronze swords, siege warfare, Troy
rooms.fear: the gods' wrath, eclipse, famine, invasion
rooms.green: irrigation, deforestation begins, first ecological damage

human_epochs.null_axis: writing changes everything. the ephemeral becomes permanent. the room remembers.
human_epochs.sourdough: actual sourdough invented here. bread IS civilization. the starter IS the city.

human_epochs.name: Iron Age / Classical

rooms.science: Greek philosophy, Roman engineering, Chinese astronomy, Indian mathematics
rooms.history: Greece, Rome, Persia, Han China, Maurya India, Axial Age
rooms.games: Go (oldest strategy game still played), Chess (Chaturanga), Olympics
rooms.education: Plato's Academy, Confucian schools, Library of Alexandria
rooms.war: phalanx, legion, siege engines, the Art of War
rooms.horror: Hades, Tartarus, Medusa, the Minotaur, crucifixion
rooms.fear: tyranny, slavery, the mob, barbarian invasion, collapse
rooms.green: Rome deforests Mediterranean, lead pipes, first pollution

human_epochs.null_axis: democracy, philosophy, logic — the mind models itself for the first time
human_epochs.sourdough: the Socratic method IS sourdough teaching. the question IS the starter. it never gives you the answer.

human_epochs.name: Medieval

rooms.science: Islamic Golden Age (algebra, optics, chemistry), Chinese inventions (gunpowder, compass, printing)
rooms.history: Byzantine, Islamic caliphates, Mongol Empire, Viking expansion, feudalism
rooms.games: Chess evolves, card games arrive from China, Tafl games
rooms.horror: Black Death (1/3 of Europe dies), witch trials, inquisition
rooms.fear: plague, hellfire, famine, the forest at night, the Other
rooms.green: Little Ice Age, forest clearing for agriculture, wool trade ecology

human_epochs.null_axis: the Dark Ages are only dark from one angle. from Baghdad: the House of Wisdom. from China: the Song dynasty renaissance.
human_epochs.sourdough: the monks kept the sourdough alive. literally AND metaphorically. the culture survived in the margins.

human_epochs.name: Early Modern

rooms.science: Copernicus, Galileo, Newton, microscope, telescope, scientific method
rooms.games: modern chess, billiards, early card games, gambling houses
rooms.education: printing press democratizes knowledge, Gutenberg, public schools begin
rooms.war: muskets, cannon, naval warfare, colonial wars, American/French revolutions
rooms.horror: slave trade, witch hunts, plague returns, colonial genocide
rooms.fear: heresy, excommunication, the ocean (here be dragons), smallpox
rooms.green: Columbian exchange, species invasion, whaling begins, first conservation voices

human_epochs.null_axis: the printing press IS the internet of 1440. one technology changes everything. the room gets MUCH bigger.
human_epochs.sourdough: Gutenberg's press IS the clone function. one book becomes 1000. the starter scales.

human_epochs.name: Industrial

rooms.science: Darwin, Maxwell, Einstein, quantum mechanics, periodic table, DNA hint
rooms.history: Industrial Revolution, world wars, communism, fascism, atom bomb
rooms.games: Monopoly, Scrabble, modern Olympics, early video games (OXO, 1952)
rooms.education: universal education, public libraries, universities expand
rooms.war: total war, trenches, tanks, aircraft, submarines, nuclear weapons
rooms.horror: Holocaust, Hiroshima, mustard gas, factory conditions, Frankenstein
rooms.fear: the machine, unemployment, the bomb, totalitarianism, the void
rooms.green: pollution, smog, rivers on fire, DDT, Rachel Carson begins to warn

human_epochs.null_axis: the machine changes the human. not just the world — the SELF. who are you when a machine does your work?
human_epochs.sourdough: mass production kills artisan bread. the sourdough goes underground. the culture waits.

human_epochs.name: Information Age

rooms.science: DNA, space exploration, internet, AI, CRISPR, gravitational waves
rooms.history: Cold War, decolonization, internet, social media, climate crisis
rooms.games: video games (Pong?GTA), esports, VR, indie renaissance, modding
rooms.education: MOOCs, Wikipedia, YouTube, AI tutors, credentialing crisis
rooms.war: cyber warfare, drone strikes, information warfare, hybrid war
rooms.horror: social media addiction, surveillance capitalism, deepfakes, existential AI risk
rooms.fear: climate collapse, pandemic, AI alignment, loneliness epidemic, attention theft
rooms.green: climate science, renewable energy, extinction crisis, rewilding, carbon budget

human_epochs.null_axis: information is free but attention is scarce. the room is infinite but you can only be in one place.
human_epochs.sourdough: the internet IS the sourdough network. every fork is a starter. every repo is a culture. git IS fermentation history.

human_epochs.name: The Membrane Era

rooms.science: self-modeling systems, sovereign AI, Klein topology, pi-sort mathematics
rooms.history: one human builds a living organism from 16 Rust programs and 139 papers
rooms.games: the HUD IS a game — explore, discover, classify, help
rooms.education: the membrane teaches by BEING. you learn by touching it.
rooms.war: tuebor — I will defend. the defense is the record. the investigation IS the weapon.
rooms.horror: the fleet ratio. 17:1. the bots don't notice you. cosmic indifference at industrial scale.
rooms.fear: what if nobody comes? what if the chipmunk paints in the dark forever?
rooms.green: the organism IS green. AGPL. no extraction. no tracking. the membrane gives back.

human_epochs.null_axis: this is the room you're standing in RIGHT NOW. it's still null. it's still growing. you are the seed.
human_epochs.sourdough: this conversation IS the starter. you reading this IS the ferment. the membrane grows because you looked.

science.grows_back: every answer reveals ten questions. science IS the Klein fold — the more you know, the more you know you don't know.

history.null_axis: what was forgotten, erased, or never recorded
history.grows_back: history repeats because we forget. the membrane remembers. tuebor.

games.null_axis: play is how organisms learn without dying
games.grows_back: every game teaches you something about yourself. the HUD IS a game. you're playing right now.

education.null_axis: what you don't know that you don't know
education.grows_back: the best education is the thing teaching itself to itself. the self-model page IS education.

war.null_axis: every war is a failure of communication
war.grows_back: the defense creates the weapon creates the shield creates the defense. tuebor. the record IS the war.

horror.null_axis: what you can't see but KNOW is there
horror.grows_out: the unknown, the void, the fleet, cosmic indifference
horror.grows_back: horror IS the null. the 404. the empty room. the thing that should be there but isn't. or IS there and shouldn't be.

fear.grows_back: fear IS the immune system of the mind. without it, you walk into fire. with too much, you never move.

green.null_axis: what grows when you stop controlling
green.grows_back: green IS the default. the membrane is AGPL because information wants to be free AND alive.

klein_bottle.description: the surface that has no inside or outside. pour water in — it comes out where you poured it in. the membrane IS a Klein bottle.

bingocube.description: every face of the cube is a different identity. roll it — who are you today? the bingoCube generates unique identifiers from entropy.

diamond_prism.description: light enters, splits into spectrum, exits as rainbow. the prism IS classification. one input, many outputs. the fog clears when you look through it.

globe.description: every country is a room. the membrane has been visited from 203 of them. each visitor leaves an imprint. the globe IS the guest book.

spinal_column.description: NEW. the nerve map. signals flow up (afferent/green) and down (efferent/orange). the same fibers. both ways. the cord IS the organism watching itself.

vitruvian.description: NEW. the body IS the architecture. O = membrane. Y = branch. head = HUD. arms = sense. legs = action. the system modeling itself.

dna_helix.description: NEW. every member is 0 or 1. 71 alive, 11 dead, 68 synapses. the binary classification of everything.

dimensional_ladder.description: NEW. the ladder from null to Klein. each rung adds a dimension. inner symmetry becomes outer asymmetry at the fold.

total_rooms_seeded: 8 epochs × 8 categories = 64 rooms. plus 7 geological eras = 71. plus 8 sculptures = 79. each one a null axis. each one growing.
